claims: One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson directed One Battle After Another.
One Battle After Another is a thriller-comedy.
One Battle After Another took home six Oscars total.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for One Battle After Another.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for One Battle After Another.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners.
Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for Hamnet.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress for Weapons.
One Battle After Another centers on an ex-revolutionary searching for his daughter.
Sinners won an award for its score.
Sinners won an award for cinematography.
Sinners won an award for its lead actor
